key_insight: Domain–boundary coupling causes a half-order spatial convergence loss across the coupled thermoelastic variables, yielding an L² error bound of O(h^{r+1/2} + τ²).
engineering_relevance: The analysis supports mesh and time-step selection for simulations coupling acoustic potential, temperature, and boundary displacement.
method: Degree-r finite elements in space with Crank–Nicolson time stepping.
Error analysis accounts for nonlinear domain and boundary terms and nonlocal heat diffusion.
A bootstrap argument establishes uniform L∞ boundedness of the discrete acoustic potential.
evidence_signal: Numerical tests with linear, quadratic, and cubic Lagrange elements corroborate the estimates and illustrate optimal convergence under additional L∞ regularity.
watch_item: Optimal spatial rates require additional solution regularity; otherwise, the proven bound retains the coupling-induced half-order loss.
paper_title: Numerical Analysis for a Nonlinear Coupled Thermoelastic System with Acoustic Boundary Conditions
